chunks: Fear Allah regarding what you have amassed
and find out your true right therein
and turn to understand for what you will not be excused on the grounds of ignorance
Certainly, for (following the path of) obedience there are clear signs
while the mean turn away from them
Whoever turns his face from them deviates from the right
Allah takes away His bounty from him
and afflicts him with His chastisement
ai.seo_question: What are the signs of obedience and the consequences of turning away from them according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this letter to Muawiya, Imam Ali (AS) emphasizes the necessity of returning to established, undisputed knowledge (ma'rifah) to avoid the ambiguity of ignorance, framing obedience as a distinct, illuminated path. He warns that deviation from this clear trajectory results in divine displeasure and the transformation of blessings into calamities, a theme deeply resonant with Shia exegetical traditions regarding political and spiritual fidelity.
